title: Anatomy of a Closed-Loop Collapse: A Causal Case Study of a Compressed VLA Policy
abstract: arXiv:2609.23048v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Compressed manipulation policies can pass offline evaluation while failing in closed-loop execution; this dissociation is established in prior work and is not our claim. We contribute a causal anatomy of one naturally occurring case. An 8-layer distillation of Octo-Base retains 86% of parameters, passes every offline check we applied (0.996 and 1.000 teacher-ratios on the family's own validation metrics), and collapses in closed loop: 0/72 vs. the teacher's 40/72 on a simulated WidowX pick-and-place task. The collapse is structured, not diffuse: early task stages degrade gradually (the student moves the object at 90% of the teacher's rate and grasps at 55%), while transport-to-target fails categorically, at 0% in every training variant. Paired action-trace forensics isolate the signature: a negative, late-heavy $z$ residual, roughly 10x its post-repair magnitude, and persistent across the base distillation and both continuation branche

translated_title: 闭环崩溃的解剖：一个压缩VLA策略的因果案例研究
translated_abstract: 压缩的操作策略可以通过离线评估，却在闭环执行中失败；这种分离现象在先前的工作中已被确立，并非我们的主张。我们的贡献是对一个自然发生案例的因果解剖。Octo-Base的8层蒸馏版本保留了86%的参数，通过了我们应用的所有离线检查（在该系列自身的验证指标上达到0.996和1.000的教师比率），但在闭环中崩溃：在模拟的WidowX抓取放置任务上，学生模型为0/72，而教师模型为40/72。这种崩溃是结构化的，而非弥散的：早期任务阶段逐渐退化（学生模型以教师模型90%的速率移动物体，抓取成功率为55%），而向目标运输则完全失败，在所有训练变体中均为0%。配对动作轨迹取证分离出了这一失败特征：一个负向的、后期加重的z轴残差，约为修复后幅度的10倍，并且在基础蒸馏和两个延续分支中都持续存在。
tldr: 本文对一个压缩VLA策略的闭环失败进行了因果解剖，发现该模型虽通过所有离线评估指标，却因z轴负向后期残差导致向目标运输阶段完全失败，揭示了离线评估无法预测闭环执行崩溃的结构化失败机制。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a causal anatomy of a compressed VLA policy's closed-loop collapse, showing that despite passing all offline evaluations, the model fails categorically at transport-to-target due to a negative, late-heavy z-axis residual, revealing the structured failure mechanism by which offline metrics fail to predict closed-loop execution breakdown.
